recipes.description: macOS Big Sur (build 20G1443) full installer, straight from Apple's own infrastructure (current)
recipes.license: Apple Software License Agreement (macOS itself; running it is subject to Apple's terms)
recipes.caveats:
This is the installer package for macOS Big Sur, not a command. Find it with:

    hop info macos-big-sur

It's what "Install macOS Big Sur.app" is built from — expand it with `pkgutil --expand-full` to reach the app bundle, or use it
directly with a macOS VM tool such as UTM's installer-creation flow.
